title: feedback
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): closedby, ContactId, createdby, CreatedByContact, createdonbehalfby, CreatedOnBehalfByContact, FeedbackId, KnowledgeArticleId, modifiedby, ModifiedOnBehalfBy, msdyn_ContextObjectId_knowledgearticle, ownerid, owningbusinessunit, transactioncurrencyid.

adx_approved.description: Shows whether the feedback is approved for display.

adx_authorurl.description: The URL of the author’s home page/blog.

adx_contactemail.description: Email of the contact who created the record.

adx_contactusername.description: Username of the contact who created the record.

adx_createdbycontact.description: Name of the contact who created the record.

closedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was closed.

createdon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was created.

exchangerate.description: Shows the conversion rate of the record's currency.

importsequencenumber.description: Unique identifier of the data import or data migration that created this record.

modifiedon.description: Shows the date and time when the record was last updated.

normalizedrating.description: Shows the rating scaled to a value between 0 and 1 based on minimum and maximum ratings.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

rating.description: Specifies how helpful the related record was.

source.description: Shows where the feedback was submitted from.

statecode.description: Shows whether the feedback is open, rejected or closed.

title.description: Type a title for the feedback.

_createdbycontact_value.description: Shows the contact who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Shows who created the record on behalf of another user.

_createdonbehalfbycontact_value.description: Shows the contact who created the record on behalf of another user.

_modifiedby_value.description: Shows who last updated the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_msdyn_contextobjectid_value.description: Shows the record in context of which feedback rating is being provided.

_ownerid_value.description: Unique identifier of the user or team who owns the knowledge article views.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the knowledge article views.

_regardingobjectid_value.description: Shows the record that the feedback is associated with.

_transactioncurrencyid_value.description: Choose the local currency for the record to make sure budgets are reported in the correct currency.
